scenes.narration: Why does every gas station want you to come inside? Because gas isn't the money.
At U.S. convenience stores in 2025, fuel was 65 percent of sales, but less than 39 percent of gross profit.
The real money is inside. Coffee, hot food, drinks and snacks.
Prepared food alone brought in almost 39 percent of in store gross profit.

visual.label: of in-store gross profit came from food service

scenes.narration: So the gas price sign is the ad. The snack aisle is the business.

visual.text: The gas gets you to stop.
